source: Generated from local no-secret proof booleans and a read-only Neon connector probe; raw database URLs, secret values, raw smoke payloads, and sensitive user/financial data keys are rejected before writing

neon.note: Neon project access is proven, but the default neondb read-only connector probe returned zero application tables and no staging branch was discoverable by search. No raw Neon connection string is stored.

migrations.note: Migration execution proof must come from a safe validation target, staging execution, and production dry-run, not from committed database URLs. Current Neon connector proof does not verify migrated staging tables.

seeds.note: Only staging synthetic seed proof may be recorded. Current Neon connector proof does not verify a staged seed.

smoke.note: Smoke proof must be based on deployed staging API/Admin responses with sensitive payloads redacted.

rollback.note: Rollback proof must be a rehearsal or documented recovery validation, not a destructive production rollback. Current connector proof does not verify an actual staged rollback rehearsal.
